variants.name: C · Apex
variants.description: Sharp red chevrons framing a clean black centre.
variants.direction: APEX: Use two razor-sharp symmetrical red chevrons and narrow brushed silver edges rising from bottom corners, a strong angular V composition around the lower half. Keep the center matte black and undistressed with immaculate bold metallic silver WHEY. Minimal precise panel seams. No brushstroke swashes; this is the clean motorsport version. Red 25%, silver 15%, black 60%.

Match reference pouch dimensions, subtle right gusset, camera framing, studio lighting, soft shadow and generous margins. Portrait 1024x1536. variants.description: A brushed-silver face with black and red accents.
variants.direction: TITANIUM: Material-driven performance luxury. Main front face is brushed titanium silver with a large sharply angled matte-black panel across center carrying huge silver WHEY. Black zipper and black side gussets. Thin saturated red diagonal cutline and one short red solid band for flavour. Reflective metallized film contrasted with tactile black, subtle engineering precision, no invented specs or gauge numerals. This is the silver-dominant alternative within the black/red/silver family, not the original black design.

variants.description: Flowing red speed graphics with a textured finish.
variants.direction: AFTERBURN: Energetic premium sport design: matte black pouch with flowing red kinetic ribbons curving in a large asymmetric S around a central silver WHEY title, faint charcoal halftone texture and delicate silver motion trails. All small label text sits on solid black to remain readable. Adult athletic energy, no mascot, no flames, no extra slogans.
